# Security policy

The mods here run in Herdr on your computer: they read your files and start programs on it. If you find a way for one to do more than its README says, please report it privately.

## Reporting

Use [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/gsydler/herdr-cria/security/advisories/new) on this repo's Security tab, not a public issue. Say which mod, what you did and what happened.

## Supported versions

Only `main`: herdr.dev/mods installs every mod from it, so a fix lands there and nowhere else.
